parsed.explanation: Strong visitor-facing positives: no criminalisation, self-ID recognition (2017), 2024 equal-treatment grounds covering goods/services, healthcare and housing, hate-speech and employment protections, no documented border or facility exclusion. Negatives: a recent (2024) mob attack on trans people (arrests made, convictions unsourced), a survey showing low LGBT openness and fear-based avoidance (LGBT-wide, not trans-specific, so limited weight), the dominant religious authority's opposition, and dated (2013) police mistreatment of trans people with complaints discontinued. Custody defaults to registered-sex (male) placement with isolation, but a documented on-request transfer route has worked, including for a foreign national — a partial exposure with a functioning remedy, not an unremedied tier-1 rule. Net: functioning protections with real but not pervasive social hostility → Reduced Risk.
